fact: On 23 September 2026 the Interior Minister told the National Assembly's law committee that the State has been tied to Malaysia's Iris for card production since 2016, with the latest contract amendment of 29 April 2026 running to 21 May 2027, and announced a progressive internalisation of the card and passport production system through Senegalese firms.
title: Carte d'identité biométrique Cedeao, le Sénégal prépare une prorogation exceptionnelle de la validité
